topic: Data migration and demographic data visualization
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered the process of migrating historical impression data from a staging dataset to the production dataset. It was determined that this migration is straightforward, requiring only an `ALTER` and `INSERT` operation using existing scripts.

Regarding demographic data, someone confirmed receiving necessary data per facility (from Galina) and plans to integrate it into the system for visualization. This involves updating a chart component to fetch and process the new data structure, specifically ensuring selection by all or only selected facilities is possible.

Technical discussions included methods for handling JSON data in different environments (IDE vs. code) and sharing relevant SQL scripts for merging and comparing JSON structures.
decisions: The migration of historical impression data from the staging to the production dataset will be performed using existing scripts, requiring no complex recalculation or deletion steps.
action_items: Someone needs to update the demographic chart component to fetch and process new facility-specific data.
Scripts for JSON merging and diffing were shared for reference.
